method: LIGHT pass (Thursday). Re-read the fast-moving self-serve providers (RunPod, Nebius, Verda/DataCrunch, Lambda, Hyperstack, Together AI, CoreWeave, Crusoe, Voltage Park, TensorDock); the only provider with a 'changed' row in the last 7 days of refresh files (Verda) is already in that set. Read on the seller's own pricing pages by WebFetch on 2026-11-12. Rows not attempted are omitted (TensorDock benchmark rows 23-24, Verda reserved rows 91-98). Lambda (lambda.com) and live Crusoe page not fetchable this run. Status: confirmed = same price read today; changed = different price read today; unavailable = offering absent from the reference page; not_rechecked = attempted but no readable/attributable USD price today (price untouched). Per-node prices divided by GPUs per node as noted.
